name: Not reachable
description: robots.txt blocks the crawlers behind AI answers, an honest fetch is challenged, or product pages are not server-rendered.

name: Crawlable
description: robots.txt parses, the search and assistant crawlers may read product pages, an honestly identified agent is not challenged, and product content is in the HTML.

name: Readable catalog
description: Level 1, and the catalog is enumerable (product sitemap, platform API or public feed), product pages stay eligible for snippets, and they carry Product JSON-LD with a complete Offer.

name: Identifiable products
description: Level 2, and products carry a GTIN (valid) or brand plus MPN, and the brand as an entity.

name: Trusted merchant
description: Level 3, and the return, shipping, privacy and terms pages plus a contact channel are findable.

name: Transactable
description: Level 4, and a UCP profile or an ACP discovery document advertises a checkout protocol. Transactable means the public prerequisites are in place, not that a checkout was exercised.
